author: @ObnoxiousAgnostic
message: My mentor at the Jain temple taught me the navkar mantra. She also told me that, even though the svastik is a symbol in Jainism, I still shouldn’t drive with one on my rear bumper.

text: 挑戰了。如果我沒被它害死，我就能完成跳躍挑戰了。  我現在不會這麼艱難了。  就在這裡。  蝙蝠俠。 Velp。
